hook.name: TwoRewardHook
hook.description: Singleton v4 hook for a reflection token launchpad managing two phases: a bonding curve phase (CURVE) pricing tokens against a virtual 75/25 constant-product curve with exact-input-only swaps, and a graduated AMM phase charging layered ETH fees (rake + LP-deepening + dividend) on every swap. Hook-owned liquidity is seeded at graduation and permanently locked; the fee structure, graduation logic, and liquidity deepening are all permissionless post-launch.
